name: Phong Shading with Boundary Enhancement and Facing Subtraction
definition: A fragment shader implementation for volume rendering that computes Phong lighting using precomputed gradients, applies boundary enhancement via absorption approximation, and facing subtraction for silhouette enhancement.
summary: Phong Shading with Boundary Enhancement and Facing Subtraction is a volume rendering technique that modulates fragment alpha based on gradient magnitude and view direction to enhance boundaries and silhouettes.
